title: Puig hits record Q3 sales on makeup and fragrance growth
summary: The Spanish beauty group delivered record third-quarter sales in 2026, with net revenue reaching EUR 1.39 billion (USD 1.12 billion), up 5.6% on a like-for-like (LFL) basis and 7.2% at reported exchange rates. The performance was driven by fragrance and makeup, with growth across all geographical regions. For the first nine months of 2026, the Spanish beauty group generated revenue of EUR 3.74 billion (USD 4.19 billion), up 4.8% LFL and 4.1% on a reported basis.
